title: Run a Sponsor Sales Desk for Your Channel or Newsletter
summary: Score sponsor emails, price the deal from real numbers, reply with a rate and invoice once it runs.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already get some inbound brand interest.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Legit sponsors get a fast, confident answer.
Pricing from real view counts avoids underselling.
who_its_for: Creators, podcasters and newsletter owners getting brand emails.

stack.name: Sponsor Inbound Scout
stack.role: Flags real sponsor emails and screens out scams.
stack.creator: startupideaspod

stack.name: Sponsorship Negotiator
stack.role: Researches the brand and drafts a rate reply.
stack.creator: AlexFinn

stack.name: CPM
stack.role: Prices the deal from public view counts.
stack.creator: kostahantzis

stack.name: Invoice Hunter
stack.role: Chases the invoice after the post runs.
stack.creator: scheemunai

steps: Connect only the inbox you use for business.
Set your floor price and deal types.
Review each flagged email and the drafted reply.
Send, deliver, then let the invoice follow-up run.
guardrails: The bots never pay, sign or accept terms for you.
Every message and document stays a draft until you approve it.
